// Turn the HubSpot template into a plain HTML email + text version for this contact.
const cfg = $('Resolve campaign').first().json;
const contact = $input.first().json;
let html = $('Template → text').first().json.data;
const unsub = `mailto:${cfg.from_email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent('Unsubscribe ' + contact.email)}`;
html = html
  .replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '')
  .replace(/\{%\s*text[^%]*value="([^"]*)"[^%]*%\}/g, (_, v) => cfg.preview || v)
  .replace(/\{%[\s\S]*?%\}/g, '')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*content\.name\s*\}\}/g, cfg.subject)
  .replace(/\{\{\s*contact\.firstname\s*\}\}/g, contact.firstname || 'there')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*unsubscribe_link(_all)?\s*\}\}/g, unsub)
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_name\s*\}\}/g, 'MOKIPOPS')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_street_address_1\s*\}\}/g, '')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_street_address_2\s*\}\}/g, '')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_city\s*\}\}/g, 'Atlanta')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_state\s*\}\}/g, 'GA')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_zip\s*\}\}/g, '')
  .replace(/\{\{\s*site_settings\.company_country\s*\}\}/g, 'USA')
  .replace(/\{\{[^}]*\}\}/g, '');
const text = html
  .replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, '')
  .replace(/<a [^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi, (_, h, t) => `${t.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim()} (${h})`)
  .replace(/<\/(p|div|tr|h\d|li)>/gi, '\n')
  .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
  .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
  .replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/'/g, "'").replace(/"/g, '"')
  .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
return [{ json: { ...contact, subject: cfg.subject, html, text, from: `${cfg.from_name} <${cfg.from_email}>`, reply_to: cfg.from_email, campaign: cfg.campaign } }];
